title: Qman DirectPath role-constrained trust key ring
x-qmanInteroperableIntegerRange: Every JSON numeric integer is in -9007199254740991..9007199254740991 before canonicalization; wider values use schema-defined decimal strings.
x-qmanSignatureRule: Set rootSignatures to [] and keyRingDigest to null, encode the complete ring with CANONICAL-JSON-V1, and store its SHA-256 in keyRingDigest. For each stored rootSignature, form the closed signature envelope {rootKeyId:<exact rootKeyId>,signedAt:<exact signedAt>,keyRingDigest:<stored keyRingDigest>} and verify Ed25519 over ASCII(QMAN-DIRECTPATH/TRUST-KEY-RING/V1) || 0x00 || CANONICAL-JSON-V1(envelope) against the offline root set. Thus signedAt is signed rather than removed with rootSignatures. The candidate ring contains no receipt/hash of the external anchor that accepts it, preventing a digest fixed point; after verification, external monotonic state is compared and advanced independently.
x-qmanKeyIdentityRule: principalId is the immutable enterprise IAM/HSM principal bound to this signed key entry. Reassigning an existing keyId or public key to another principal is invalid; rotation creates a new keyId. No two keyIds in one ring may reuse publicKeyBase64Url. Approval.identity must byte-equal the principalId resolved through approval.keyId.
x-qmanSeparationOfDutiesRule: QUALIFICATION_ENGINEERING and PRODUCT_RELEASE use distinct keyIds, public-key material and principalIds. TARGET_ARCHITECT, SECURITY and TEST approvals use three distinct keyIds, three distinct public keys and three distinct principalIds; no one principal or key may hold two of those roles. QualificationRecord signerKeyId/principalId must differ from the Product Release signer of the consuming SupportedCatalog and QualificationReleaseIndex. CONTROL_REPOSITORY_EVIDENCE signs only a repository transaction result after the repository has atomically consumed a host receipt; HOST_RELEASE_EVIDENCE cannot impersonate that independent authority.
